item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 29/Oct/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. It will be windy over the region. The easterly airstream will moderate slightly on Friday. Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, temperatures will fall slightly over the coastal areas of southern China during the weekend and early next week. An area of low pressure over the western North Pacific, east of the Philippines is expected to bring unsettled weather to the region in the latter part of this week, and edge closer to the vicinity of the Philippines in the middle part of next week.
